what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Vietnam in Hong Kong SAR, China: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2015, the last year with a figure, UNHCR counted 488 Vietnamese asylum seekers in Hong Kong SAR, China, 11.2% of all asylum seekers from Vietnam.
Refugees from Vietnam, a separate group, live mostly in France, the United Kingdom, Germany and Thailand.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Vietnam, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2013 to 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group runs from 2002, at 5 asylum seekers, to 2015.
Its highest and last figure is for 2015.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Hong Kong SAR, China.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Hong Kong SAR, China only; the data has no figure after 2015.
